request.prompt_preview: CASE FILE Question: Site S-SFX-001 in Sfax dropped off the air in the early hours of this morning. Is this an outage we need to escalate? Now: 2026-09-03 09:00 (Thursday, Africa/Tunis). Data after thi

response.text: Site S-SFX-001 dropped off the air between 03:00 and 05:00 today, matching precisely with scheduled maintenance window MW-0001 (battery swap with expected impact: site down) (T1, T4, T5). Sibling site S-SFX-002 remained unaffected, and normal operations resumed fully by 05:00 (T5). Therefore, this was a planned maintenance activity rather than an unexpected outage requiring escalation.
